description: a strong broad-shouldered young woman with a long dark braid falling from under the helmet, in dark blackened steel plate armour engraved with bright copper lightning bolts, a grey wolf fur cloak over the shoulders, a dark steel helmet with two curved aurochs horns, copper-trimmed gauntlets and dark steel boots, a long broad sword with a copper hilt in the front hand and a round dark shield with a copper lightning sign on the other arm, seen from the side, facing and walking to the right, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the character's look: face, hair, clothes, colours and what the hands hold
the pose, size and place of the figure: seen from the side, facing right, upright mid-step; copy it exactly
